    Preprojective components #

    A preprojective component (PreprojComp) is a nonempty class of nonzero indecomposables, closed under isomorphism and under irreducible maps in both directions, in which every member has finitely many predecessors up to isomorphism (of bounded dimension) and lies on no cycle.

    Members are directing (PreprojComp.directing).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.AR.PreprojComp {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (𝒞 : FDMod k A → Prop) :
    Prop

    A preprojective component.

    • nonempty : ∃ (X : FDMod k A), 𝒞 X
    • indNT (X : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → IndNT X
    • iso (X Y : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → IsoM X Y → 𝒞 Y
    • pred (X Y : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → IndNT Y → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X), IsIrr f → 𝒞 Y
    • succ (X Y : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → IndNT Y → ∀ (f : X ⟶ Y), IsIrr f → 𝒞 Y
    • finPred (X : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → ∃ (b : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y : FDMod k A), PredN X n Y → Module.finrank k Y.carrier ≤ b
    • finIso (X : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → ∃ (L : List (FDMod k A)), ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y : FDMod k A), PredN X n Y → ∃ Z ∈ L, IsoM Y Z
    • noCycle (X : FDMod k A) : 𝒞 X → ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y : FDMod k A), 0 < n → PredN X n Y → ¬IsoM Y X
